g.text: Fankata found temperatures from k10temp, nvme and acpitz,
but no fan control. The board’s sensor driver may not be loaded.
Finds out why fans are missing, and fixes what it can.
Found two ITE chips: IT8688E and IT8792E
This kernel’s it87 driver doesn’t know the IT8688E
sudo apt install dkms git build-essential linux-headers-$(uname -r)
Load it87 without a boot option
